description: Zero/low-allocation behavior tree library: one shared immutable tree per archetype, one compact NodeState[] per agent, 0 B per tick.
A .NET library of Clean Architecture building blocks that enforce layer boundaries and domain rules.
Typed .NET client for the Migadu REST API: domains, mailboxes, identities, forwardings, aliases and rewrites. Unofficial: not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Migadu.
